### POST /api/v1/access-delegations/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `access_delegations_create` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/access-delegations/` |
| Business purpose | Add (access delegations). |
| Requirements | [HIMS-IAM-017](../../../requirements/identity-and-access.md#hims-iam-017) |
| Actor / permission required | `access.assignments.manage` (Grant and revoke role assignments). System roles holding it: Organization administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session; a "confirm it's you" within the last 15 minutes is required |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | `AccessDelegationCreateRequest`: `delegator` (required, uuid), `delegate` (required, uuid), `starts_at` (date-time), `ends_at` (required, date-time), `reason` (required, ≤ 2000 characters), `assignments` |
| Response schema | 201 `AccessDelegationCreated` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Refused in the wrong state with `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE`, `NOT_DELEGABLE` |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | `Idempotency-Key` header (optional; operation `access_delegations.create`): the same key with the same body replays the stored answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); with a different body 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; kept 48 hours |
| Concurrency control | The row is locked while it changes, so two requests never both win |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | `access.delegation.created`, `access.role.assigned`, `access.role.revoked` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | Messages (email; SMS printed on the console until a gateway is chosen): tried at once and logged; a failure never undoes the action |
| Timeout and retry policy | messages: email timeout 20 s; a failed message is retried every few minutes with a growing pause, up to 5 tries, then shows as failed with Send again; the client may retry a lost answer with the same Idempotency-Key |
| Expected error codes | 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, 400 `INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`, 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 403 `REAUTH_REQUIRED`, 409 `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE`, 409 `CONFLICT`, 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, 409 `INVALID_PERIOD`, 409 `NOTHING_TO_DELEGATE`, 409 `NOT_DELEGABLE`, 409 `OVERLAPPING`, 409 `REASON_REQUIRED`, 409 `SAME_PERSON`, 409 `SELF_ASSIGNMENT`, 409 `START_IN_PAST`, 409 `TOO_LONG`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/access_control/tests/test_delegations.py::test_auditor_access_and_lent_access_are_never_lent`, `apps/access_control/tests/test_delegations.py::test_lent_administrator_access_never_counts_as_an_administrator` |
